title: Interior design and layout
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise the G60 interior’s overall look and cabin layout, while many other mentions are too brief to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the interior’s appearance, overall appeal, and layout as standout aspects of the vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly fragmentary mentions of the interior without enough context to tell whether the customer approved or disliked it.

limitations: The sampled examples are dominated by repeated generic praise, so detail on specific interior features is limited.
Undetermined examples are sparse and brief, which limits interpretation of what customers meant by those mentions.
